text: Narrowed: JDK-specific. 'sbt -java-home ~/Library/Java/JavaVirtualMachines/openjdk-22/Contents/Home coreJVM/doc' succeeds (18 s); the same task on Homebrew JDK 25.0.1 (sbt's default here) fails deterministically with the SignatureBuilder NPE. Unexplained: publishLocal doc jars succeeded on JDK 25 at 22:50/23:00. Options for the owner: run doc/publish/release on JDK 21/22 (pin via .sbtopts '-java-home' or a .java-version file), or move to a Scala 3 LTS patch whose scaladoc supports JDK 25. Not changed in the build yet: pinning the JDK is a project-wide decision.
